name: journal
description: Journal-discipline tooling for a VardeMem-backed agent: the Journal is the append-only store VardeMem indexes, and these hooks keep it well-formed and non-empty. enforce-journal-entry (Stop) blocks a session once when it did substantive work and wrote nothing to the Journal; enforce-journal-tags (PreToolUse) denies an untagged new entry; preload-spine (SessionStart, PostCompact) injects the episodic spine; remind-journal-owed (UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact) adds one non-blocking reminder line when `vardemem owed`, the check the scheduled reminder also calls, says the session's commits have earned a Journal line. The gates are opt-in per tenant (config under the trusted passwd/token home at <home>/.config/journal/, not derived from $HOME; $JOURNAL_CONFIG_DIR overrides), every hook fails open, and each is disable-able by name in $JOURNAL_DISABLED (the legacy $HARNESS_MANAGEMENT_DISABLED is honored). The journal path is never hardcoded; it is resolved the way vardemem resolves it (trusted walk from cwd for .vardemem.json, then $AGENT_VAULT). Version lives in the consuming marketplace, never here.
